notes.title: Update the translation of the English subtitles.
notes.content:
1. Modified some known bugs.
2. The English subtitles have been upgraded from previous machine translation to more professional translation.

notes.title: Fix known bugs.
notes.content:
1. Fixed the black screen issue caused by clicking on ending nodes.
2. Added auto-save functionality for settings when the language is set to English.
3. Fixed the bug that continuously checked configurations at startup.

notes.title: Fixed some known bugs.
notes.content:
The update addressed some of the stuttering, black screen, and video looping bugs caused by compatibility issues.

If there are still similar issues, you can provide feedback on the official QQ group or community forum, and we will promptly look into it.

notes.title: Fixing lagging and black screen bugs.
notes.content:
After two days of testing, most of the lagging and black screen bugs reported by some players have been fixed. 

If you still encounter these issues, please kindly provide feedback in the official QQ group.

notes.title: Updated on April 28th
notes.content:
Fixed some known bugs.

Based on player feedback regarding issues such as getting electrocuted in Chapter 3 and getting stuck in the fish pond in Chapter 4, more specific hints have been added to the ending page. Players can follow these hints to try and complete the level.

For the lag issues reported by some players, some have already been resolved, while others are still being adjusted. If you encounter any problems, please feel free to provide feedback in the official group.

notes.title: Cyber love, emotions at full throttle! "Custom Girlfriend" is now available on
notes.content:
This Labor Day, spend the holiday with your cyber girlfriends Xiao Xi and Feifei from the girl group!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967439/bf256f346c82996e656f3cad9ca8f8fb265435b1.png[/img]
Players will embark on a new adventure accompanied by two beautiful women. The unique dual-heroine design allows players to navigate between the two, indulging in a smooth experience.

Wave after wave of high-energy plots, refuse to be dull! Refuse to be sluggish! Let players focus more on the emotional impact brought by the two beauties, maximizing emotional value.

At the same time, confrontations escalate, with the introduction of shady entertainment company bosses and super hackers. It's not just about dating them, it's about going on adventures with them too!

With great anticipation, let's interact with them together!
